title: How AI Agents Pay Without a Bank Account: x402
speaker: Youssef Allali
summary: Youssef Allali walks through x402, the open protocol that lets agents pay onchain per request, and shows what five-cent data queries unlock for trading.
takeaways: Payment rails weren't built for agents: no KYC, no bank account, blocked as bots
x402 revives HTTP 402 from 1997: server quotes a price, the agent's wallet signs
Over 15 million payments but just $1M volume last month: x402 encourages micropayments
Cloudflare and AWS offer it. For anti-spam, humans read free and agents pay
Nansen data usually costs hundreds of dollars. Over x402 his agent paid $0.05
